title: GLOF prioritisation and hydrodynamic simulation in Gilgit-Baltistan and Chitral, northern Pakistan: a reproducible open-data workflow
description: Scripts (R, Python, Google Earth Engine), HEC-RAS 2D model inputs and figures for a glacial lake outburst flood (GLOF) study in Gilgit-Baltistan and Chitral, northern Pakistan. Released under the MIT License.
